stato: Approvata dall’utente e inserita nel booklet come N di «Nel Medioevo».
conversione_riferimento: Conversione HEIC in PNG per lettura e input immagine; foto originale conservata senza modifiche.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: precise portrait edit inside an existing illuminated initial.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the historiated blue-and-gold capital N containing a medieval classroom. Image 2 is the user's photograph, an IDENTITY REFERENCE for the teacher's face only.
Primary request: Adapt the teacher in Image 1 to have the recognizable facial identity of the person in Image 2, painted naturally in the same medieval manuscript illumination style.
Change only the teacher's head, face and the small adjoining neck/hood opening. He is the seated adult in the upper right, holding up the parchment and pointing to its ruled diagrams. Preserve his existing pose, downward three-quarter head direction and teaching gesture.
Likeness: faithfully translate the reference's face shape, strong dark eyebrows, brown eyes, nose, lips, close-trimmed dark beard and moustache, and short swept-up salt-and-pepper grey hair into hand-painted miniature brushwork. Keep the reference person's adult age; do not retain the old teacher's elderly face or long grey beard. Retain the small silver septum hoop and dark ear plug wherever visible, subtly rendered as part of the painted portrait. The medieval cap/hood can open slightly around the forehead to accommodate his recognizable hair, while retaining the blue and rose medieval clothing.
Style: opaque tempera, fine ink outlines, delicate handmade manuscript brushwork and restrained shading, fully matched to the existing illustration. Make the likeness recognizable without creating a photographic cutout or modern realistic face pasted into a painting.
Invariants: Keep the entire N shape, blue and gold letter strokes, all decorative foliage, palette, gilding, architecture, three pupils and their faces, desks, books, parchment diagrams, pigments, tools, objects and outer silhouette unchanged. Keep the original square framing, scale and dimensions. No added words or letters. The teacher's body and hands remain unchanged.
Transparency: Preserve the original true transparent alpha outside the illustrated initial. No background sheet, no checkerboard pattern, no cast shadow, no new frame or watermark.
